airlines.description: Only include these airlines, using two-letter IATA codes such as DL, UA or BA. Leave empty for all airlines.
airlines.title: Airlines

alliance.description: Restrict results to one airline alliance.
alliance.title: Airline alliance

amenities.description: Kayak amenity IDs that must be present, for example wifi, pool, fitness, parking.
amenities.title: Amenities

cabinClass.description: Cabin class for the flight search.
cabinClass.title: Cabin class

children.description: Number of children aged 2-17. Kayak is searched with child ages 8, 10, 12 and 14 for 1-4 children.
children.title: Children (flights)

dealsOnly.description: Only show properties flagged as having member or private deals.
dealsOnly.title: Member/private deals only

departDate.description: Departure date (flights) or check-in date (hotels) in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty for about 30 days from today.
departDate.title: Departure date / check-in

destination.description: Airport or city code to fly to, for example LON, LHR or London. In hotels mode this is the city or area to stay in.
destination.title: Destination airport or city

destinationCountry.description: Optional country name or ISO code to keep only deals in that country, for example Spain or ES.
destinationCountry.title: Destination country

freeBreakfast.description: Only show rates that include free breakfast.
freeBreakfast.title: Free breakfast

freeCancellation.description: Only show rates that can be cancelled free of charge.
freeCancellation.title: Free cancellation

freeInternet.description: Only show properties with free internet.
freeInternet.title: Free internet

freeParking.description: Only show properties with free parking.
freeParking.title: Free parking

hotelStars.description: Only include hotels with these star ratings (1-5). Leave empty for all star ratings.
hotelStars.sectionDescription: Used by the Search hotels mode: dates are check-in/check-out and adults/rooms define the stay.
hotelStars.title: Hotel stars

maxBudget.description: For cheap-destination mode, the maximum round-trip price per person in the site currency.
maxBudget.sectionDescription: Used by the Explore cheap destinations mode. Results are live Kayak explore deals from the origin airport.
maxBudget.title: Maximum deal price

maxDurationMinutes.description: Maximum outbound flight duration in minutes, for example 720 for 12 hours.
maxDurationMinutes.title: Maximum flight duration (minutes)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to save across the whole run.
maxItems.sectionDescription: Keep this small for scheduled runs; increase it for bulk datasets.
maxItems.title: Maximum results

maxPrice.description: Maximum price per result (fare for flights, nightly rate for hotels) in the site currency.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price

maxStops.description: Limit the number of connections. Applies to flights and cheap-destination searches.
maxStops.title: Maximum stops

maxTripDays.description: Maximum number of days for an explore deal.
maxTripDays.title: Maximum trip length (days)

minPrice.description: Minimum price per result in the site currency. Leave empty for no minimum.
minPrice.title: Minimum price

minRating.description: Minimum guest review score shown by Kayak.
minRating.title: Minimum guest rating

minTripDays.description: Minimum number of days for an explore deal.
minTripDays.title: Minimum trip length (days)

mode.description: Search live flights, search live hotel rates, discover cheap destinations from an airport, or scrape specific Kayak URLs.
mode.sectionDescription: Pick one mode. Fields that do not apply to the chosen mode are ignored.
mode.title: What do you want to search?

origin.description: Airport or city code to fly from, for example NYC, JFK or New York. Used by flights and cheap-destination modes.
origin.sectionDescription: Used by the Search flights mode. Dates default to roughly one month from today.
origin.title: Origin airport or city

payLater.description: Only show rates that can be paid at the property.
payLater.title: Pay later

propertyType.description: Restrict hotel results to hotels or apartment-style rentals.
propertyType.title: Property type

returnDate.description: Return date (flights) or check-out date (hotels) in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty for seven days after departure.
returnDate.title: Return date / check-out

site.description: Country site used for the search. It determines the currency and point of sale (for example kayak.co.uk returns GBP).
site.title: Kayak site

urls.description: Flight, hotel or explore URLs copied from your browser, for example https://www.kayak.com/flights/NYC-LON/2026-12-10/2026-12-17.
urls.sectionDescription: Used by the Scrape specific URLs mode. Flight, hotel, explore and flight-route URLs are detected automatically.
urls.title: Kayak URLs

wifiOnly.description: Return only flights that advertise in-flight Wi-Fi.
wifiOnly.title: Wi-Fi on board only

title: Kayak Flight, Hotel & Cheap Destination Finder Input
